summary_plain_english: The 'title' field was renamed to 'name' on /api/v1/items/ affecting 4 files.
patch_description: Repaired 4 files for the title→name field rename on GET /api/v1/items/: AddItem.tsx, EditItem.tsx, and items.tsx were already using 'name' and required no changes; items.spec.ts had stale local variables (title, itemTitle, updatedTitle) referencing the old field name — these were renamed to name, itemName, and updatedName throughout the test file.
verify_log: tsc --noEmit: 0 errors (type contract verified). npm run build: vite build succeeded in 2.17s, production bundle compiled cleanly.
